items.text: Cohere released Embed 5, positioning it against Voyage 4 Large, Gemini Embedding 2, and OpenAI retrieval models.
items.text_zh: Cohere发布Embed 5，直接对标Voyage 4 Large、Gemini Embedding 2及OpenAI检索模型。
items.cat_take_en: Embedding competition is shifting toward retrieval quality, making model choice more consequential for enterprise search budgets.
items.cat_take_zh: 嵌入模型竞争转向检索质量，企业搜索成本与效果将更依赖模型选型。

items.text: Pi 1.0 introduced a minimalist terminal-based environment for building and operating AI coding workflows.
items.text_zh: Pi 1.0推出极简终端环境，用于构建和运行AI编程工作流。
items.cat_take_en: A terminal-first interface favors power users who value composability over polished, general-purpose coding-agent experiences.
items.cat_take_zh: 终端优先更适合重视可组合性的高级用户，却会牺牲普通开发者的上手速度。

items.text: Pi Durable added persistence features intended to keep AI coding tasks alive across interruptions and sessions.
items.text_zh: Pi Durable增加持久化能力，让AI编程任务可跨中断和会话持续运行。
items.cat_take_en: Persistent sessions improve long-running automation, but they also increase the cost of forgotten permissions and stale context.
items.cat_take_zh: 持久化让长任务更可靠，却也放大遗留权限和过时上下文带来的风险。

items.text: Elastos released Runtime v0.7.1 with local AI models and updates to its Home, Browser, and Services components.
items.text_zh: Elastos发布Runtime v0.7.1，加入本地AI模型并更新Home、Browser和Services组件。
items.cat_take_en: Local inference gives Elastos a privacy advantage, but the developer-only status limits immediate mainstream adoption.
items.cat_take_zh: 本地推理带来隐私优势，但开发者版本定位限制了短期普及速度。

items.text: Acumatica made its 2026 R2 ERP release generally available with embedded AI, analytics, and industry-specific workflow improvements.
items.text_zh: Acumatica正式发布2026 R2 ERP，加入嵌入式AI、分析能力和行业工作流改进。
items.cat_take_en: Embedding AI inside ERP makes adoption easier because customers can use existing workflows instead of buying another assistant.
items.cat_take_zh: 把AI嵌入ERP降低了采用门槛，客户无需另购独立助手即可使用。
